answer: Route admission through a trust-flow cap on the social graph: an agent's weight is the max-flow of endorsements reaching it from a vetted seed set. Honest and fake regions connect only across a thin copper thread of genuine vouching edges, so flow over that cut is bounded no matter how vast the sybil ocean behind it. Spin up ten thousand clones by dawn and they still share those few attack edges, admitting no more total weight than one honestly-vouched node. Growth demands new distinct human endorsements, which cannot be minted.
